basic_profile.bio: Hello, I'm a horticulture enthusiast from Portland, Oregon, with a penchant for seed-saving and sustainable gardening. I work as a landscape architect, which keeps me creatively engaged with nature. In my free time, I enjoy cataloging my extensive seed collection and experimenting with heirloom varieties. I'm also a fan of retro cartoons and post-apocalyptic survival games. Usually online during the evenings, especially after work hours. Currently single and enjoying the freedom to explore various hobbies and interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Environmental Science and have been self-teaching seed-saving techniques through books and online resources. My work as a landscape architect has also given me practical experience in plant care and garden design.
